title: FreshSMP
description: FreshSMP is a network with large Survival & Lifesteal servers, as well as Skyblock & Duels.
body:
FreshSMP is a network featuring competitive Lifesteal & laid back Survival, as well as Skyblock and Duels.

## Features
- Custom Limited Gear
- Terralith Terrain
- Economy Heavy
- PvP Warzone and Outposts

Servers occassionally reset bringing new seasonal content, and introducing the latest vanilla features.
